        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Create objects of the defined types
        self.desk = Object("desk", self.Location)
        self.outlet = Object("outlet", self.Location)
        self.printer_location = Object("printer_location", self.Location)
        self.cord_storage = Object("cord_storage", self.Location)
        self.printer = Object("printer", self.ObjectType)
        self.short_cord = Object("short_cord", self.ObjectType)
        self.long_cord = Object("long_cord", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents - describe world state, used in action preconditions/effects
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.printer_plugged = Fluent("printer_plugged", BoolType())
        self.using_long_cord = Fluent("using_long_cord", BoolType())

        self.office_is_formal = Fluent("office_is_formal", BoolType())
        self.staff_present = Fluent("staff_present", BoolType())

        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_office, self.desk_is_personal_space, self.office_is_formal, self.staff_present]

        navigate_to_desk.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.printer_location), False)

        get_long_cord.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.long_cord)))
        get_long_cord.add_effect(self.object_at(self.long_cord, self.cord_storage), False)
        get_long_cord.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.long_cord), True)
        get_long_cord.add_effect(self.using_long_cord, True)

        # Move printer action - robot moves printer to accessible location
        move_printer = InstantaneousAction("move_printer")
        move_printer.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.desk))
        move_printer.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.printer, self.desk))

        plug_in_printer.add_precondition(Not(self.printer_plugged))
        plug_in_printer.add_effect(self.printer_plugged, True)

        # Plug in printer with long cord action - robot plugs in printer using long cord
        plug_in_printer_long_cord = InstantaneousAction("plug_in_printer_long_cord")
        plug_in_printer_long_cord.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.outlet))
